Fields.Name: Item ID
Fields.Description: The item this shop row sells. Equipment Type sets its list.

Fields.Name: Sale Price
Fields.Description: How many souls this item costs in a shop. The attunement menu ignores it.

Fields.Name: Material ID
Fields.Description: Extra items this purchase also costs. None means the buyer pays souls only.

Fields.Name: Stock Flag ID
Fields.Description: Where the game saves how many of this item sold. The game needs it only when Quantity limits stock.

Fields.Name: World Tendency ID
Fields.Description: Unused in this game. A Demon's Souls leftover.

Fields.Name: Quantity
Fields.Description: How many of this item the shop can sell. -1 means unlimited. Limited stock needs a Stock Flag ID to save what sold.

Fields.Name: Shop Type
Fields.Description: Which shop menu shows this row. A row never appears in another menu.

Fields.Name: Equipment Type
Fields.Description: Which item list holds the Item ID. Must match the item above.
